PokeO_GableHouse.title: Gabled house
PokeO_GableHouse.drawn: Three copies of the gabled house: a pink front gable roof with its ridge front to back in stripes under a light band, a dormer with a triangular window on its left slope, a khaki gable with a small window over a light board, cream walls, the red door and a window, a teal strip along the foot.

PokeO_SkylightHouse.title: Skylight house
PokeO_SkylightHouse.drawn: Two copies of the skylight house: a pink split roof, flat on the right with a skylight in it and on the left a facet in courses sloping down to its eave; a band of wall with a small high window under its front edge, a light board, cream walls, the red door and a window, a teal strip along the foot.

PokeO_WideHouse.title: Wide house
PokeO_WideHouse.drawn: The wide house at the top right: the skylight house's split roof six tiles wide with two grey rooftop units on its flat part; in front of its middle a wing under a lower split roof, the red door in it, a mailbox and a small tree before it; two high windows over a window on the main block's front, cream walls, a teal strip along the foot.
